description: Remix ideas now live in React Router's framework tools. This course teaches routes, nested pages and browser data loading in a small single-page app. It uses local data and avoids a runtime server. Use React Router 7 framework mode, the continuation of Remix's framework approach. Save files at the shown app paths. Set ssr:false in react-router.config.ts for this browser-only course. React tooling is required.
versionNote: Uses React Router 7 framework mode and clientLoader/clientAction concepts, not legacy Remix package imports.
whatYouWillLearn: Learn to add an about route entry and its module
Learn to mark the exact place a child page will appear
Learn to add a visible underline rule for .current
learningObjectives: Learn to add an about route entry and its module
